detail.longDescription: > Our commitment is that, over time, your subscription will continue to help you get more work done with an increasing level of quality. > Starting October 30, 2026, your included usage in ChatGPT Work and Codex will decrease from 20 times to 10 times the ChatGPT Plus allowance. > For those who want even more usage and speed, the new Pro 500 tier offers our highest usage allowance, with 25 times the usage of Plus.
